title: Chandigarh power-department strike blackout
summary: Employees of the UT Electricity Department went on strike against privatisation. Large parts of Chandigarh lost power, some areas for more than a day, with no staff available to restore supply.
what_happened: Power went out across many sectors and was not restored for long stretches because staff were on strike.
Traffic signals went dark and water supply, which depends on electric pumps, was disrupted.
Hospitals had to rely on backup generators; routine work was reported to be affected.
The Punjab and Haryana High Court intervened and the strike was called off.
source_note: Based on public news reports from February 2022. The casualty and patient numbers inside this drill are Ripple's simulation, not historical figures. Verify details before formal training use.

title: Record monsoon rain and tricity floods
summary: Exceptionally heavy rain on 8–9 July 2023 flooded large parts of the tricity. Sukhna Lake's floodgates were opened, and low-lying housing societies in Zirakpur and Dhakoli, as well as roads in Mohali and Chandigarh, went under water.
what_happened: Roads and underpasses across Chandigarh, Mohali and Zirakpur were waterlogged.
Sukhna Lake's floodgates were opened as the water level rose, adding to flows downstream.
Residents of ground-floor flats in low-lying Zirakpur and Dhakoli societies were stranded or evacuated.
Schools were closed and people were advised to stay indoors.
